skill.summary: EU AI Act risk classification, Article 12 compliance logging, and self-assessment reports — deadline August 2, 2026

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of EU AI Act compliance toolkit.

- Offers Article 12 compliance logging and mapping.
- Supports paid self-assessments, Annex IV technical documentation, Annex V declarations, and full compliance reports.
